messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to match the hairstyle shape shown in the reference images (front and back views). Transfer only the hairstyle from the reference images; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's existing hair color, facial identity, clothing, and everything else in the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first action change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then walks a few steps forward and to the right, turning her head to look around the area.","camera":"A medium full-body shot from a slightly elevated angle, with the camera remaining mostly static as the character moves.","clothing":"She wears a grey and white patterned sleeveless crop top, high-waisted teal-green wide-leg pants, and brown strappy sandals.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short blue hair with straight bangs and a small bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build, light skin, and a dark choker necklace.","scene":"An outdoor industrial or dockside area with cracked concrete ground, wooden pallets, rusty pipes, and stone walls in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair was restyled from a short bob with straight bangs and a small back bun into a more voluminous, textured updo with side-swept bangs and a higher, fuller bun, matching the reference hairstyle shape. Her hair remains bright blue, and her face, clothing, scene, and motion appear otherwise consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the character's hairstyle to match the reference images' shape, while preserving her blue hair color, facial identity, clothing, and the rest of the video.
uncertain: Exact match to the reference hairstyle shape is difficult to verify from the available angles.
